title: Rehab after knee ligament surgery
also: physical therapy after knee ligament surgery
what: After knee ligament surgery, the knee is slowly brought back to movement and the leg muscles are strengthened. It takes months, and your results depend on doing the sessions.
why: After surgery to rebuild the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) of the knee.
duration: a session usually takes 45 to 60 minutes; full recovery usually takes several months
tell_doctor: Exactly what was done in your knee, since the meniscus is sometimes repaired too
What your surgeon allowed: putting weight on the leg, a brace
Pain and swelling in the knee
What sport you want to return to

prepare.title: Brace and crutches
prepare.text: If you were given them, bring them to every session.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Shorts or loose trousers, and sports shoes.

prepare.title: Cold
prepare.text: At home, keep a cold pack ready for your knee after sessions.

steps: In the first weeks, the swelling is reduced and you learn to straighten the knee fully
You learn to walk with crutches, then without them
The knee is bent a little more each time
The thigh and buttock muscles are strengthened
You practice balancing on one leg
Later come running, jumping, and sport-specific exercises
feel: The knee aches and swells after sessions
Straightening and bending hurt and feel hard at first
The thigh muscle feels weak at first
after: Do your exercises at home every day
After exercise, use cold and keep your leg raised
Do not start running or sport before your doctor allows it
Return to sport only after your knee strength and stability are checked
red_flags: Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or the knee is hot and red
The knee gave way and feels unstable again

faq.a: Usually after a few months, once your strength is checked. Your doctor will give you the exact time.

faq.q: Why does it take so long?
faq.a: The new ligament needs time to settle in and get strong. Loading it too early can tear it.

reminders.text: Knee session today. Bring your brace, crutches, and sports shoes.
